Fakturan är attesterad med avstämningen: The invoice is approved with its match against the purchase order, so the link cannot be removed.
Raden :name är avstämd mot en leverantör: The row :name is matched against a supplier invoice, so it cannot be removed.
Skriv en procentsats mellan 0 och 100, t: Enter a percentage between 0 and 100, for example 2 or 2.5.

Ingen rad hade ett belopp som stämmer me: No row had an amount that matches exactly one order row. Choose the order row yourself.

The deviation is accepted with your reason.
En avvikelse utanför toleranserna stoppa: A deviation outside the tolerances stops the approval until someone allowed to approve has accepted it with a reason.
En avvikelse utanför toleranserna visas: A deviation outside the tolerances is shown at approval but does not stop it.
Ingen avstämning ännu. Fördela fakturans: No match yet. Allocate the invoice's rows to the order rows below.
Raderna stäms av när fakturan är registr: The rows are matched once the invoice is registered.
Fakturarad utan orderrad: Invoice row without an order row
Skriv vad som gör att raden kan betalas,: Write what makes the row payable, not details about people.
Välj vilken orderrad varje fakturarad be: Choose which order row each invoice row pays for and how many, in the order row's unit. Freight and rounding can stay without an order row.
När en leverantörsfaktura är kopplad til: When a supplier invoice is linked to a purchase order, each row is compared with what was ordered and what has been received. The invoice may charge for at most the received quantity plus the quantity tolerance, and the price may exceed the order price by at most the price percentage or the amount, whichever is larger.
Stoppa attesten vid avvikelser utanför t: Stop the approval on deviations outside the tolerances
Fakturan kan då attesteras först när någ: The invoice can then be approved only once someone allowed to approve has accepted the deviation with a reason. Without the tick the deviation is shown at approval but does not stop it.

En kreditnota stäms inte av mot inköpsor: A credit note is not matched against purchase orders.
Fakturan väntar inte på attest. Avstämni: The invoice is not waiting for approval. The match is kept as it was when the invoice was approved.

Du har förberett fakturan och kan därför: You prepared the invoice and therefore cannot accept the deviation. Someone else allowed to approve needs to do it.
Avstämningen har ändrats sedan den visad: The match has changed since it was shown. Look at the new one and accept the deviation there if it can still be accepted.
Raden avviker inte från inköpsordern uta: The row does not deviate from the purchase order outside the tolerances.
Nothing has been received on the order row.
Fakturan tar betalt för fler än som har: The invoice charges for more than has been received.
The price is higher than in the purchase order.
Fakturaraden hör inte till någon orderra: The invoice row belongs to no order row.
Rader utan orderrad, inom beloppsgränsen: Rows without an order row, within the amount limit (for example freight or rounding).
Fakturan tar betalt för färre än som har: The invoice charges for fewer than have been received.
The price is lower than in the purchase order.
Du fördelade fakturans rader mot inköpso: You allocated the invoice's rows to the purchase order and therefore cannot approve it. Someone else allowed to approve needs to do it.
Avstämningen mot inköpsordern har ändrat: The match against the purchase order has changed since it was shown. Reload the page and look at it again before you approve.

Fakturan avviker från inköpsordern. Bara: The invoice deviates from the purchase order. Only someone allowed to approve supplier invoices can remove the link.
Bara den som får ändra företagets attest: Only someone allowed to change the company's approval rules can change the match against purchase orders.
Bara ägare och administratörer kan ändra: Only owners and administrators can change the match, because it governs the approval.
Fakturan avviker från inköpsordern och d: The invoice deviates from the purchase order and you allocated its rows, so someone else allowed to approve needs to remove the link.
